set.body:
Close the remaining fmrireg GLS gaps: voxelwise AR, iterative GLS, robust-triggered phi re-estimation, and censor/AR interactions. Keep global/shared AR as the fast path and make voxelwise AR chunk-safe.

Acceptance: typed AutocorrelationConfig rejects impossible combinations; current GLS tests still pass; new tests cover iterative updates, censor reset behavior, global vs voxelwise estimates, and fmrireg-backed fixtures.
set.title: Complete GLS and AR parity surface
